textFills.title: Schedule change
lines: Everyone ___ planned to come should still come.
Please send your questions to Ms. Reed ___ Wednesday.
zh: 星期二的會議已經改到星期四。
原本打算參加的人還是請來。
請在星期三以前把問題寄給 Ms. Reed。

blanks.note: 會議是被改期，要用被動式，主詞 meeting 是單數。
指人的關係子句用 who。

textFills.title: Your order
lines: Thank you for your order. We ___ your payment yesterday.
Your boxes will arrive ___ three days.
zh: 謝謝您的訂購。我們昨天收到了您的款項。
您的箱子會在三天內送到。
如果您的訂單有任何問題，請打電話給我。

options: The hotel room I booked was very small.
Please call me if there is a problem with your order.
Most of the staff were at the trade fair.
Our lunch is provided every Friday.
blanks.note: 這封信在講訂單，只有這句接得上。

textFills.title: Your booking
lines: We tried to call you while you ___ the booking form.
Please call us ___ you arrive at the hotel.
zh: 您填寫訂房表格的時候，我們試著打電話給您。
您一到飯店，請打電話給我們。
請仔細閱讀我們的飯店規定。

blanks.note: while 加過去進行式，主詞 you 用 were。
「一到就打電話」用 as soon as。
修飾動詞 read 要用副詞 carefully。

textFills.title: Trade fair information
lines: The fair is open ___ the weekend, from ten to six.
If you ___ early, you will get a free bag.
Many companies show their new ___ at the fair.
zh: 展覽在週末期間開放，從十點到六點。
如果您早點來，就能拿到一個免費的袋子。
很多公司在展覽上展示他們的新產品。

blanks.note: if 子句用現在式，不加 will。
their new 後面接名詞，複數 products。
